title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DigitalServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/DigitalServiceOffering. The virtual base class for any kind of digital service (for inheritance, not for instantiation). Subclass of GaiaXEntity per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the GaiaXEntity model and not repeated here. Included here per the full-ontology translation scope even though the source ontology marks it as a base class not meant for direct instantiation.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DigitalServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

digitalServiceOfferingName.description: Property. A human readable name of the service offering.

digitalServiceOfferingShortDescription.description: Property. A short textual description (not contractual).

digitalServiceOfferingProvider.description: Relationship. A resolvable link to the Gaia-X Credential of the participant providing the service. Links to a LegalPerson entity.

digitalServiceOfferingIdentifier.description: Property. A unique UUID identifier for the service offering.

keyword.description: Property. Keywords that describe/tag the service.

digitalServiceOfferingLaunchDate.description: Property. Date and time when the service offering can be instantiated (xsd:string in the source ontology).

digitalServiceOfferingEndDate.description: Property. Date and time when the service instances will be stopped (xsd:string in the source ontology).

digitalServiceOfferingTermsAndConditions.description: Relationship. The terms and conditions that apply to the provider (SLA, ...). Links to a ServiceTermsAndConditions entity.

digitalServiceUsageTermsAndConditions.description: Relationship. The terms and conditions that apply to the consumer. Links to a UsageTermsAndConditions entity.

digitalServiceUsageDataPolicy.description: Relationship. Defines how the supplier can use the data related to customer usage. Links to a TermsAndConditions entity.

digitalServiceLegalDocuments.description: Relationship. A list of legal documents governing the service offering delivery. Links to one or more LegalDocument entities.

digitalServiceOfferingContactInformation.description: Relationship. The contact information where prospects/customers can reach the provider. Links to a ContactInformation entity.
